description: Ten sensors on a set clock, with attachments, limits, sources and a stop event; and its unclosed copy.
origin_note: unit-clock microseconds of the first file's header start (RtcProvider's fixed date plus uptime); every *_rel_us is microseconds after it

files.name: values.mf4
files.description: Ten sensors on a set clock (2026-11-07T10:00:00Z, time class 10): an analog input with a linear table and sqrt(x) * 2 + 1 (with its raw value, no limits), an indicator (limits 0 and 1), a virtual sensor with Only new data, a coolant sensor with a linear table and no expression (limits -20 and 140), a fuel sensor with a cubic table (no limits), two CAN signal sensors (an analog one, and an indicator with limits 0 and 1), a script analog sensor, a script indicator (no limits) and a control indicator (limits 0 and 1); 40 ticks of 100 ms, the four stored configurations attached, closed by StopLogging() with the stop event (overruns 3, frames dropped 11).

files.name: values_unclosed.mf4
files.description: The same session as values.mf4 without StopLogging(): the stream just before the stop (UnFinMF, no stop event). The attachments are in its header all the same.
